set.tovw: 1889 local account: hoax by a land seeker; no treasure
set.pl: Silver Lake pond, about 4 mi W of Casey (Guthrie/Adair line); pond not placed; pin is a Casey placeholder
set.st: Mar 1889: a 'ghost' haunting Silver Lake pond, about 4 mi W of Casey, was shot with buckshot by a farmer and proved to be a man 'suspected to be a land seeker who wished to scare the owners and buy the adjoining land cheap' (Cedar Rapids Gazette, from Casey). No indexed telling mentions gold or treasure; the Frank James treasure-hunting gloss appears only in a North Dakota reprint of 12 Apr 1889. Pin is a placeholder at Casey.
set.t: No treasure: the 1889 'ghost' was a land speculator scaring owners. Look-only history note.

src: Quad-City Times, 2 Mar 1889, p. 4; Waterloo Courier, 20 Mar 1889, p. 2

set.tovw: One wire; part recovered 1907; remainder legend only

tw-ia-patterson-sugar-camp-1907.st: The story: about 20 years earlier an artist killed an old Jewish peddler carrying $5,000 and buried it in 'metallic receptacles'; an Anamosa lifer told a cellmate, who dug six weeks a year without success. In July 1907 W. A. Maulsby and B. W. Stout recovered 'a fair-sized sum' (the $5,000 guess 'probably too high'), reportedly with a medium's help; more searching followed.
src: Marshalltown Times-Republican, 25 Jul 1907, p. 2 'Others Join in the Search' (Newspapers.com 352737786; Des Moines Tribune 26 Jul p. 3 same wire)

pinev: Parcel-level: 1913 Standard Atlas of Eaton County shows the 20-acre farm in the S part of the W½ SE¼ sec. 27 T1N R6W (about 200 m).

1895 Eaton Co plat, Bellevue plate p. 16 (Ancestry image 31617_072120-00134): 'Chas. Dolph' then held a strip in N-central sec 36 T1N R6W, about 3.5 km SE; the 1913 parcel (closer to the 1914 dig) is kept. 'J. S. Grohe 160' = NE¼ sec 34, drawn as swamp, directly S of the 1913 farm: the stumps were 'back of' the Grohe swamp on the Dolph land.

tw-mi-bellevue-dolph-stumps.t: Grohe swamp (NE¼ sec 34, 1895 plat) is the wetland just S of the 1913 farm; it is the landmark, not the dig site.
